it will be see that this mere painstaking burrower and grub - worm of a poor devil of a sub - sub appear to have go through the long vaticans and street - stall of the earth , pick up whatever random allusion to whale he could anyways find in any book whatsoever , sacred or profane . therefore you must not , in every case at least , take the higgledy - piggledy whale statement , however authentic , in these extract , for veritable gospel cetology . far from it . as touch the ancient author generally , as well as the poet here appear , these extract be solely valuable or entertaining , as afford a glancing bird 's eye view of what have be promiscuously say , think , fancy , and sing of leviathan , by many nation and generation , include our own .
so fare thee well , poor devil of a sub - sub , whose commentator i be . thou belong to that hopeless , sallow tribe which no wine of this world will ever warm ; and for whom even pale sherry would be too rosy - strong ; but with whom one sometimes love to sit , and feel poor - devilish , too ; and grow convivial upon tear ; and say to they bluntly , with full eye and empty glass , and in not altogether unpleasant sadness -- give it up , sub - subs ! for by how much the more pain ye take to please the world , by so much the more shall ye for ever go thankless ! would that i could clear out hampton court and the tuileries for ye ! but gulp down your tear and hie aloft to the royal - mast with your heart ; for your friend who have go before be clear out the seven - storied heaven , and make refugee of long - pamper gabriel , michael , and raphael , against your coming . here ye strike but splinter heart together -- there , ye shall strike unsplinterable glass !

chapter 1
looming .
call i ishmael . some year ago -- never mind how long precisely -- have little or no money in my purse , and nothing particular to interest i on shore , i think i would sail about a little and see the watery part of the world . it be a way i have of drive off the spleen and regulate the circulation . whenever i find myself grow grim about the mouth ; whenever it be a damp , drizzly november in my soul ; whenever i find myself involuntarily pause before coffin warehouse , and bring up the rear of every funeral i meet ; and especially whenever my hypos get such an upper hand of i , that it require a strong moral principle to prevent i from deliberately step into the street , and methodically knock people 's hat off -- then , i account it high time to get to sea as soon as i can . this be my substitute for pistol and ball . with a philosophical flourish cato throw himself upon his sword ; i quietly take to the ship . there be nothing surprising in this . if they but know it , almost all man in their degree , some time or other , cherish very nearly the same feeling towards the ocean with i .
there now be your insular city of the manhattoes , belt round by wharf as indian isle by coral reef -- commerce surround it with her surf . right and leave , the street take you waterward . its extreme downtown be the battery , where that noble mole be wash by wave , and cool by breeze , which a few hour previous be out of sight of land . look at the crowd of water - gazer there .
circumambulate the city of a dreamy sabbath afternoon . go from corlears hook to coenties slip , and from thence , by whitehall , northward . what do you see?--poste like silent sentinel all around the town , stand thousand upon thousand of mortal man fix in ocean revery . some lean against the spile ; some seat upon the pier - head ; some look over the bulwark of ship from china ; some high aloft in the rigging , as if strive to get a still well seaward peep . but these be all landsman ; of week day pen up in lath and plaster -- tie to counter , nail to bench , clinch to desk . how then be this ? be the green field go ? what do they here ?
but look ! here come more crowd , pace straight for the water , and seemingly bind for a dive . strange ! nothing will content they but the extreme limit of the land ; loiter under the shady lee of yonder warehouse will not suffice . no . they must get just as nigh the water as they possibly can without fall in . and there they stand -- mile of they -- league . inlander all , they come from lane and alley , street and avenue -- north , east , south , and west . yet here they all unite . tell i , do the magnetic virtue of the needle of the compass of all those ship attract they thither ?
once more . say you be in the country ; in some high land of lake . take almost any path you please , and ten to one it carry you down in a dale , and leave you there by a pool in the stream . there be magic in it . let the most absent - minded of man be plunge in his deep revery -- stand that man on his leg , set his foot a - going , and he will infallibly lead you to water , if water there be in all that region . should you ever be athirst in the great american desert , try this experiment , if your caravan happen to be supply with a metaphysical professor . yes , as every one know , meditation and water be wed for ever .
but here be an artist . he desire to paint you the dreamy , shady , quiet , most enchanting bit of romantic landscape in all the valley of the saco . what be the chief element he employ ? there stand his tree , each with a hollow trunk , as if a hermit and a crucifix be within ; and here sleep his meadow , and there sleep his cattle ; and up from yonder cottage go a sleepy smoke . deep into distant woodland wind a mazy way , reach to overlap spur of mountain bath in their hill - side blue . but though the picture lie thus trance , and though this pine - tree shake down its sigh like leaf upon this shepherd 's head , yet all be vain , unless the shepherd 's eye be fix upon the magic stream before he . go visit the prairies in june , when for score on score of mile you wade knee - deep among tiger - lily -- what be the one charm wanting?--water -- there be not a drop of water there ! be niagara but a cataract of sand , would you travel your thousand mile to see it ? why do the poor poet of tennessee , upon suddenly receive two handful of silver , deliberate whether to buy he a coat , which he sadly need , or invest his money in a pedestrian trip to rockaway beach ? why be almost every robust healthy boy with a robust healthy soul in he , at some time or other crazy to go to sea ? why upon your first voyage as a passenger , do you yourself feel such a mystical vibration , when first tell that you and your ship be now out of sight of land ? why do the old persians hold the sea holy ? why do the greeks give it a separate deity , and own brother of jove ? surely all this be not without meaning . and still deep the meaning of that story of narcissus , who because he could not grasp the tormenting , mild image he see in the fountain , plunge into it and be drown . but that same image , we ourselves see in all river and ocean . it be the image of the ungraspable phantom of life ; and this be the key to it all .
now , when i say that i be in the habit of go to sea whenever i begin to grow hazy about the eye , and begin to be over conscious of my lung , i do not mean to have it infer that i ever go to sea as a passenger . for to go as a passenger you must needs have a purse , and a purse be but a rag unless you have something in it . besides , passenger get sea - sick -- grow quarrelsome -- don't sleep of night -- do not enjoy themselves much , as a general thing;--no , i never go as a passenger ; nor , though i be something of a salt , do i ever go to sea as a commodore , or a captain , or a cook . i abandon the glory and distinction of such office to those who like they . for my part , i abominate all honourable respectable toil , trial , and tribulation of every kind whatsoever . it be quite as much as i can do to take care of myself , without take care of ship , barque , brig , schooner , and what not . and as for go as cook,--though i confess there be considerable glory in that , a cook be a sort of officer on ship - board -- yet , somehow , i never fancy broil fowls;--though once broil , judiciously butter , and judgmatically salt and pepper , there be no one who will speak more respectfully , not to say reverentially , of a broil fowl than i will . it be out of the idolatrous doting of the old egyptians upon broil ibis and roasted river horse , that you see the mummy of those creature in their huge bake - house the pyramid .
no , when i go to sea , i go as a simple sailor , right before the mast , plumb down into the forecastle , aloft there to the royal mast - head . true , they rather order i about some , and make i jump from spar to spar , like a grasshopper in a may meadow . and at first , this sort of thing be unpleasant enough . it touch one 's sense of honour , particularly if you come of an old establish family in the land , the van rensselaers , or randolphs , or hardicanute . and more than all , if just previous to put your hand into the tar - pot , you have be lord it as a country schoolmaster , make the tall boy stand in awe of you . the transition be a keen one , i assure you , from a schoolmaster to a sailor , and require a strong decoction of seneca and the stoics to enable you to grin and bear it . but even this wear off in time .
what of it , if some old hunk of a sea - captain order i to get a broom and sweep down the deck ? what do that indignity amount to , weigh , i mean , in the scale of the new testament ? do you think the archangel gabriel think anything the less of i , because i promptly and respectfully obey that old hunk in that particular instance ? who be not a slave ? tell i that . well , then , however the old sea - captain may order i about -- however they may thump and punch i about , i have the satisfaction of know that it be all right ; that everybody else be one way or other serve in much the same way -- either in a physical or metaphysical point of view , that be ; and so the universal thump be pass round , and all hand should rub each other 's shoulder - blade , and be content .
again , i always go to sea as a sailor , because they make a point of pay i for my trouble , whereas they never pay passenger a single penny that i ever hear of . on the contrary , passenger themselves must pay . and there be all the difference in the world between pay and be pay . the act of pay be perhaps the most uncomfortable infliction that the two orchard thief entail upon we . but be paid,--what will compare with it ? the urbane activity with which a man receive money be really marvellous , consider that we so earnestly believe money to be the root of all earthly ill , and that on no account can a monied man enter heaven . ah ! how cheerfully we consign ourselves to perdition !
finally , i always go to sea as a sailor , because of the wholesome exercise and pure air of the fore - castle deck . for as in this world , head wind be far more prevalent than wind from astern ( that be , if you never violate the pythagorean maxim ) , so for the most part the commodore on the quarter - deck get his atmosphere at second hand from the sailor on the forecastle . he think he breathe it first ; but not so . in much the same way do the commonalty lead their leader in many other thing , at the same time that the leader little suspect it . but wherefore it be that after having repeatedly smell the sea as a merchant sailor , i should now take it into my head to go on a whale voyage ; this the invisible police officer of the fates , who have the constant surveillance of i , and secretly dog i , and influence i in some unaccountable way -- he can well answer than any one else . and , doubtless , my go on this whale voyage , form part of the grand programme of providence that be draw up a long time ago . it come in as a sort of brief interlude and solo between more extensive performance . i take it that this part of the bill must have run something like this :
" grand contest election for the presidency of the united states . " whale voyage by one ishmael . " bloody battle in affghanistan . "

nantucket ! take out your map and look at it . see what a real corner of the world it occupy ; how it stand there , away off shore , more lonely than the eddystone lighthouse . look at it -- a mere hillock , and elbow of sand ; all beach , without a background . there be more sand there than you would use in twenty year as a substitute for blot paper . some gamesome wight will tell you that they have to plant weed there , they do not grow naturally ; that they import canada thistle ; that they have to send beyond sea for a spile to stop a leak in an oil cask ; that piece of wood in nantucket be carry about like bit of the true cross in rome ; that people there plant toadstool before their house , to get under the shade in summer time ; that one blade of grass make an oasis , three blade in a day 's walk a prairie ; that they wear quicksand shoe , something like laplander snow - shoe ; that they be so shut up , belt about , every way inclose , surround , and make an utter island of by the ocean , that to their very chair and table small clam will sometimes be find adhere , as to the back of sea turtle . but these extravaganza only show that nantucket be no illinois .
look now at the wondrous traditional story of how this island be settle by the red - man . thus go the legend . in olden time an eagle swoop down upon the new england coast , and carry off an infant indian in his talon . with loud lament the parent see their child bear out of sight over the wide water . they resolve to follow in the same direction . set out in their canoe , after a perilous passage they discover the island , and there they find an empty ivory casket,--the poor little indian 's skeleton .
what wonder , then , that these nantucketers , bear on a beach , should take to the sea for a livelihood ! they first catch crab and quohog in the sand ; grow bolder , they wad out with net for mackerel ; more experienced , they push off in boat and capture cod ; and at last , launch a navy of great ship on the sea , explore this watery world ; put an incessant belt of circumnavigation round it ; peep in at behring 's straits ; and in all season and all ocean declare everlaste war with the mighty animate mass that have survive the flood ; most monstrous and most mountainous ! that himmalehan , salt - sea mastodon , clothe with such portentousness of unconscious power , that his very panic be more to be dread than his most fearless and malicious assault !
and thus have these naked nantucketers , these sea hermit , issue from their ant - hill in the sea , overrun and conquer the watery world like so many alexander ; parcel out among they the atlantic , pacific , and indian ocean , as the three pirate power do poland . let america add mexico to texas , and pile cuba upon canada ; let the english overswarm all india , and hang out their blaze banner from the sun ; two third of this terraqueous globe be the nantucketer 's . for the sea be his ; he own it , as emperor own empire ; other seaman have but a right of way through it . merchant ship be but extension bridge ; armed one but float fort ; even pirate and privateer , though follow the sea as highwayman the road , they but plunder other ship , other fragment of the land like themselves , without seek to draw their living from the bottomless deep itself . the nantucketer , he alone reside and riot on the sea ; he alone , in bible language , go down to it in ship ; to and fro plough it as his own special plantation . there be his home ; there lie his business , which a noah 's flood would not interrupt , though it overwhelm all the million in china . he live on the sea , as prairie cock in the prairie ; he hide among the wave , he climb they as chamois hunter climb the alps . for year he know not the land ; so that when he come to it at last , it smell like another world , more strangely than the moon would to an earthsman . with the landless gull , that at sunset fold her wing and be rock to sleep between billow ; so at nightfall , the nantucketer , out of sight of land , furl his sail , and lay he to his rest , while under his very pillow rush herd of walrus and whale .

a day or two pass , and there be great activity aboard the pequod . not only be the old sail be mend , but new sail be come on board , and bolt of canvas , and coil of rigging ; in short , everything betoken that the ship 's preparation be hurry to a close . captain peleg seldom or never go ashore , but sit in his wigwam keep a sharp look - out upon the hand : bildad do all the purchasing and provide at the store ; and the man employ in the hold and on the rigging be work till long after night - fall .

every one know what a multitude of thing -- bed , sauce - pan , knife and fork , shovel and tong , napkin , nut - cracker , and what not , be indispensable to the business of housekeeping . just so with whaling , which necessitate a three - year ' housekeeping upon the wide ocean , far from all grocer , costermonger , doctor , baker , and banker . and though this also hold true of merchant vessel , yet not by any mean to the same extent as with whaleman . for besides the great length of the whale voyage , the numerous article peculiar to the prosecution of the fishery , and the impossibility of replace they at the remote harbor usually frequent , it must be remember , that of all ship , whale vessel be the most expose to accident of all kind , and especially to the destruction and loss of the very thing upon which the success of the voyage most depend . hence , the spare boat , spare spar , and spare line and harpoon , and spare everything , almost , but a spare captain and duplicate ship .
at the period of our arrival at the island , the heavy storage of the pequod have be almost complete ; comprise her beef , bread , water , fuel , and iron hoop and stave . but , as before hint , for some time there be a continual fetching and carry on board of diver odd and end of thing , both large and small .

the advocate .

in behalf of the dignity of whaling , i would fain advance naught but substantiate fact . but after embattle his fact , an advocate who should wholly suppress a not unreasonable surmise , which might tell eloquently upon his cause -- such an advocate , would he not be blameworthy ?
it be well know that at the coronation of king and queen , even modern one , a certain curious process of season they for their function be go through . there be a saltcellar of state , so call , and there may be a castor of state . how they use the salt , precisely -- who know ? certain i be , however , that a king 's head be solemnly oil at his coronation , even as a head of salad . can it be , though , that they anoint it with a view of make its interior run well , as they anoint machinery ? much might be ruminate here , concern the essential dignity of this regal process , because in common life we esteem but meanly and contemptibly a fellow who anoint his hair , and palpably smell of that anointing . in truth , a mature man who use hair - oil , unless medicinally , that man have probably get a quoggy spot in he somewhere . as a general rule , he can not amount to much in his totality .
but the only thing to be consider here , be this -- what kind of oil be use at coronation ? certainly it can not be olive oil , nor macassar oil , nor castor oil , nor bear 's oil , nor train oil , nor cod - liver oil . what then can it possibly be , but sperm oil in its unmanufactured , unpolluted state , the sweetest of all oil ?
think of that , ye loyal britons ! we whalemen supply your king and queen with coronation stuff !

the specksynder .
concern the officer of the whale - craft , this seem as good a place as any to set down a little domestic peculiarity on ship - board , arise from the existence of the harpooneer class of officer , a class unknown of course in any other marine than the whale - fleet .
the large importance attach to the harpooneer 's vocation be evince by the fact , that originally in the old dutch fishery , two century and more ago , the command of a whale ship be not wholly lodge in the person now call the captain , but be divide between he and an officer call the specksynder . literally this word mean fat - cutter ; usage , however , in time make it equivalent to chief harpooneer . in those day , the captain 's authority be restrict to the navigation and general management of the vessel ; while over the whale - hunt department and all its concern , the specksynder or chief harpooneer reign supreme . in the british greenland fishery , under the corrupted title of specksioneer , this old dutch official be still retain , but his former dignity be sadly abridge . at present he rank simply as senior harpooneer ; and as such , be but one of the captain 's more inferior subaltern . nevertheless , as upon the good conduct of the harpooneer the success of a whale voyage largely depend , and since in the american fishery he be not only an important officer in the boat , but under certain circumstance ( night watch on a whale ground ) the command of the ship 's deck be also his ; therefore the grand political maxim of the sea demand , that he should nominally live apart from the man before the mast , and be in some way distinguished as their professional superior ; though always , by they , familiarly regard as their social equal .
now , the grand distinction draw between officer and man at sea , be this -- the first life aft , the last forward . hence , in whale - ship and merchantman alike , the mate have their quarter with the captain ; and so , too , in most of the american whaler the harpooneer be lodge in the after part of the ship . that be to say , they take their meal in the captain 's cabin , and sleep in a place indirectly communicate with it .
though the long period of a southern whaling voyage ( by far the long of all voyage now or ever make by man ) , the peculiar peril of it , and the community of interest prevail among a company , all of whom , high or low , depend for their profit , not upon fix wage , but upon their common luck , together with their common vigilance , intrepidity , and hard work ; though all these thing do in some case tend to beget a less rigorous discipline than in merchantman generally ; yet , never mind how much like an old mesopotamian family these whaleman may , in some primitive instance , live together ; for all that , the punctilious external , at least , of the quarter - deck be seldom materially relaxed , and in no instance do away . indeed , many be the nantucket ship in which you will see the skipper parade his quarter - deck with an elated grandeur not surpass in any military navy ; nay , extort almost as much outward homage as if he wear the imperial purple , and not the shabbiest of pilot - cloth .
and though of all man the moody captain of the pequod be the least give to that sort of shallow assumption ; and though the only homage he ever exact , be implicit , instantaneous obedience ; though he require no man to remove the shoe from his foot ere step upon the quarter - deck ; and though there be time when , owe to peculiar circumstance connect with event hereafter to be detail , he address they in unusual term , whether of condescension or in terrorem , or otherwise ; yet even captain ahab be by no mean unobservant of the paramount form and usage of the sea .
nor , perhaps , will it fail to be eventually perceive , that behind those form and usage , as it be , he sometimes mask himself ; incidentally make use of they for other and more private end than they be legitimately intend to subserve . that certain sultanism of his brain , which have otherwise in a good degree remain unmanifested ; through those form that same sultanism become incarnate in an irresistible dictatorship . for be a man 's intellectual superiority what it will , it can never assume the practical , available supremacy over other man , without the aid of some sort of external art and entrenchment , always , in themselves , more or less paltry and base . this it be , that for ever keep god 's true prince of the empire from the world 's husting ; and leave the high honour that this air can give , to those man who become famous more through their infinite inferiority to the choice hide handful of the divine inert , than through their undoubted superiority over the dead level of the mass . such large virtue lurk in these small thing when extreme political superstition invest they , that in some royal instance even to idiot imbecility they have impart potency . but when , as in the case of nicholas the czar , the ring crown of geographical empire encircle an imperial brain ; then , the plebeian herds crouch abase before the tremendous centralization . nor , will the tragic dramatist who would depict mortal indomitableness in its full sweep and direct swing , ever forget a hint , incidentally so important in his art , as the one now allude to .
but ahab , my captain , still move before i in all his nantucket grimness and shagginess ; and in this episode touch emperor and king , i must not conceal that i have only to do with a poor old whale - hunter like he ; and , therefore , all outward majestical trapping and housing be deny i . oh , ahab ! what shall be grand in thee , it must need be pluck at from the sky , and dive for in the deep , and feature in the unbodied air !

now , as the business of stand mast - head , ashore or afloat , be a very ancient and interesting one , let we in some measure expatiate here . i take it , that the early stander of mast - head be the old egyptians ; because , in all my research , i find none prior to they . for though their progenitor , the builder of babel , must doubtless , by their tower , have intend to rear the lofty mast - head in all asia , or africa either ; it may seem unwarrantable to couple in any respect the mast - head stander of the land with those of the sea ; but that in truth it be not so , be plainly evince by an item for which obed macy , the sole historian of nantucket , stand accountable . the worthy obed tell we , that in the early time of the whale fishery , ere ship be regularly launch in pursuit of the game , the people of that island erect lofty spar along the sea - coast , to which the look - out ascend by mean of nailed cleat , something as fowl go upstairs in a hen - house . a few year ago this same plan be adopt by the bay whaleman of new zealand , who , upon descry the game , give notice to the ready - manned boat nigh the beach . but this custom have now become obsolete ; nay , to a dreamy meditative man it be delightful . there you stand , a hundred foot above the silent deck , stride along the deep , as if the mast be gigantic stilt , while beneath you and between your leg , as it be , swim the huge monster of the sea , even as ship once sail between the boot of the famous colossus at old rhodes . there you stand , lose in the infinite series of the sea , with nothing ruffle but the wave . the trance ship indolently roll ; in one of those southern whalesman , on a long three or four year ' voyage , as often happen , the sum of the various hour you spend at the mast - head would amount to several entire month . and it be much to be deplore that the place to which you devote so considerable a portion of the whole term of your natural life , should be so sadly destitute of anything approach to a cosy inhabitiveness , or adapt to breed a comfortable localness of feeling , such as pertain to a bed , a hammock , a hearse , a sentry box , a pulpit , a coach , or any other of those small and snug contrivance in which man temporarily isolate themselves . your most usual point of perch be the head of the t ' gallant - mast , where you stand upon two thin parallel stick ( almost peculiar to whaleman ) call the t ' gallant cross - tree . here , toss about by the sea , the beginner feel about as cosy as he would stand on a bull 's horn . to be sure , in cold weather you may carry your house aloft with you , in the shape of a watch - coat ; but properly speak the thick watch - coat be no more of a house than the unclad body ; for as the soul be glue inside of its fleshy tabernacle , and can not freely move about in it , nor even move out of it , without run great risk of perish ( like an ignorant pilgrim cross the snowy alps in winter ) ; so a watch - coat be not so much of a house as it be a mere envelope , or additional skin encase you . you can not put a shelf or chest of drawer in your body , and no more can you make a convenient closet of your watch - coat .

but if we southern whale - fisher be not so snugly house aloft as captain sleet and his greenlandmen be ; yet that disadvantage be greatly counter - balanced by the widely contrast serenity of those seductive sea in which we south fisher mostly float . for one , i use to lounge up the rigging very leisurely , rest in the top to have a chat with queequeg , or any one else off duty whom i might find there ; then ascend a little way far , and throw a lazy leg over the top - sail yard , take a preliminary view of the watery pasture , and so at last mount to my ultimate destination .
let i make a clean breast of it here , and frankly admit that i keep but sorry guard . with the problem of the universe revolve in i , how could i -- be leave completely to myself at such a thought - engendering altitude -- how could i but lightly hold my obligation to observe all whale - ship ' standing order , " keep your weather eye open , and sing out every time . "
and let i in this place movingly admonish you , ye ship - owner of nantucket ! beware of enlist in your vigilant fishery any lad with lean brow and hollow eye ; give to unseasonable meditativeness ; and who offer to ship with the phaedon instead of bowditch in his head . beware of such an one , i say ; your whale must be see before they can be kill ; and this sunken - eyed young platonist will tow you ten wake round the world , and never make you one pint of sperm the rich . nor be these monition at all unneeded . for nowadays , the whale - fishery furnish an asylum for many romantic , melancholy , and absent - minded young man , disgust with the carking care of earth , and seek sentiment in tar and blubber . childe harold not unfrequently perch himself upon the mast - head of some luckless disappointed whale - ship , and in moody phrase ejaculates:--
" roll on , thou deep and dark blue ocean , roll ! ten thousand blubber - hunter sweep over thee in vain . "
very often do the captain of such ship take those absent - minded young philosopher to task , upbraid they with not feel sufficient " interest " in the voyage ; half - hint that they be so hopelessly lose to all honourable ambition , as that in their secret soul they would rather not see whale than otherwise . but all in vain ; those young platonists have a notion that their vision be imperfect ; they be short - sighted ; what use , then , to strain the visual nerve ? they have leave their opera - glass at home .
" why , thou monkey , " say a harpooneer to one of these lad , " we have be cruise now hard upon three year , and thou hast not raise a whale yet . whale be scarce as hen 's tooth whenever thou art up here . " perhaps they be ; or perhaps there might have be shoal of they in the far horizon ; but lull into such an opium - like listlessness of vacant , unconscious reverie be this absent - minded youth by the blend cadence of wave with thought , that at last he lose his identity ; take the mystic ocean at his foot for the visible image of that deep , blue , bottomless soul , pervade mankind and nature ; and every strange , half - see , gliding , beautiful thing that elude he ; every dimly - discover , uprise fin of some undiscernible form , seem to he the embodiment of those elusive thought that only people the soul by continually flit through it . in this enchant mood , thy spirit ebb away to whence it come ; become diffused through time and space ; like crammer 's sprinkle pantheistic ash , form at last a part of every shore the round globe over .
there be no life in thee , now , except that rock life impart by a gently rolling ship ; by she , borrow from the sea ; by the sea , from the inscrutable tide of god . but while this sleep , this dream be on ye , move your foot or hand an inch ; slip your hold at all ; and your identity come back in horror . over descartian vortex you hover . and perhaps , at mid - day , in the fair weather , with one half - throttle shriek you drop through that transparent air into the summer sea , no more to rise for ever . heed it well , ye pantheists !

if two stranger cross the pine barrens in new york state , or the equally desolate salisbury plain in england ; if casually encounter each other in such inhospitable wild , these twain , for the life of they , can not well avoid a mutual salutation ; and stop for a moment to interchange the news ; and , perhaps , sit down for a while and rest in concert : then , how much more natural that upon the illimitable pine barrens and salisbury plains of the sea , two whale vessel descry each other at the end of the earth -- off lone fanning 's island , or the far away king 's mill ; how much more natural , i say , that under such circumstance these ship should not only interchange hail , but come into still close , more friendly and sociable contact . and especially would this seem to be a matter of course , in the case of vessel own in one seaport , and whose captain , officer , and not a few of the man be personally know to each other ; and consequently , have all sort of dear domestic thing to talk about .

gam . noun -- a social meeting of two ( or more ) whaleship , generally on a cruising - ground ; when , after exchange hails , they exchange visit by boats ' crews ; the two captain remain , for the time , on board of one ship , and the two chief mate on the other .

with reference to the whale scene shortly to be describe , as well as for the well understanding of all similar scene elsewhere present , i have here to speak of the magical , sometimes horrible whale - line .
the line originally use in the fishery be of the good hemp , slightly vapoure with tar , not impregnate with it , as in the case of ordinary rope ; for while tar , as ordinarily use , make the hemp more pliable to the rope - maker , and also render the rope itself more convenient to the sailor for common ship use ; yet , not only would the ordinary quantity too much stiffen the whale - line for the close coiling to which it must be subject ; but as most seaman be begin to learn , tar in general by no means add to the rope 's durability or strength , however much it may give it compactness and gloss .
of late year the manilla rope have in the american fishery almost entirely supersede hemp as a material for whale - line ; for , though not so durable as hemp , it be strong , and far more soft and elastic ; and i will add ( since there be an aesthetic in all thing ) , be much more handsome and become to the boat , than hemp . hemp be a dusky , dark fellow , a sort of indian ; but manilla be as a golden - haired circassian to behold .
the whale - line be only two - third of an inch in thickness . at first sight , you would not think it so strong as it really be . by experiment its one and fifty yarn will each suspend a weight of one hundred and twenty pound ; so that the whole rope will bear a strain nearly equal to three ton . in length , the common sperm whale - line measure something over two hundred fathom . towards the stern of the boat it be spirally coil away in the tub , not like the worm - pipe of a still though , but so as to form one round , cheese - shape mass of densely bed " sheaf , " or layer of concentric spiralization , without any hollow but the " heart , " or minute vertical tube form at the axis of the cheese . as the least tangle or kink in the coiling would , in run out , infallibly take somebody 's arm , leg , or entire body off , the utmost precaution be use in stow the line in its tub . some harpooneer will consume almost an entire morning in this business , carry the line high aloft and then reeve it downwards through a block towards the tub , so as in the act of coil to free it from all possible wrinkle and twist .
in the english boat two tub be use instead of one ; the same line be continuously coil in both tub . there be some advantage in this ; because these twin - tub be so small they fit more readily into the boat , and do not strain it so much ; whereas , the american tub , nearly three foot in diameter and of proportionate depth , make a rather bulky freight for a craft whose plank be but one half - inch in thickness ; for the bottom of the whale - boat be like critical ice , which will bear up a considerable distribute weight , but not very much of a concentrated one . when the paint canvas cover be clap on the american line - tub , the boat look as if it be pull off with a prodigious great wedding - cake to present to the whale .
both end of the line be expose ; the low end terminate in an eye - splice or loop come up from the bottom against the side of the tub , and hang over its edge completely disengage from everything . this arrangement of the low end be necessary on two account . first : in order to facilitate the fastening to it of an additional line from a neighboring boat , in case the stricken whale should sound so deep as to threaten to carry off the entire line originally attach to the harpoon . in these instance , the whale of course be shift like a mug of ale , as it be , from the one boat to the other ; though the first boat always hover at hand to assist its consort . second : this arrangement be indispensable for common safety 's sake ; for be the low end of the line in any way attach to the boat , and be the whale then to run the line out to the end almost in a single , smoking minute as he sometimes do , he would not stop there , for the doomed boat would infallibly be drag down after he into the profundity of the sea ; and in that case no town - crier would ever find she again .
before lower the boat for the chase , the upper end of the line be take aft from the tub , and pass round the loggerhead there , be again carry forward the entire length of the boat , rest crosswise upon the loom or handle of every man 's oar , so that it jog against his wrist in rowing ; and also pass between the man , as they alternately sit at the opposite gunwale , to the leaded chock or groove in the extreme pointed prow of the boat , where a wooden pin or skewer the size of a common quill , prevent it from slip out . from the chock it hang in a slight festoon over the bow , and be then pass inside the boat again ; and some ten or twenty fathom ( call box - line ) be coil upon the box in the bow , it continue its way to the gunwale still a little further aft , and be then attach to the short - warp -- the rope which be immediately connect with the harpoon ; but previous to that connexion , the short - warp go through sundry mystification too tedious to detail .
thus the whale - line fold the whole boat in its complicated coil , twisting and writhe around it in almost every direction . all the oarsman be involve in its perilous contortion ; so that to the timid eye of the landsman , they seem as indian juggler , with the deadly snake sportively festoon their limb . nor can any son of mortal woman , for the first time , seat himself amid those hempen intricacy , and while strain his utmost at the oar , bethink he that at any unknown instant the harpoon may be dart , and all these horrible contortion be put in play like ring lightning ; he can not be thus circumstance without a shudder that make the very marrow in his bone to quiver in he like a shake jelly . yet habit -- strange thing ! what can not habit accomplish?--gayer sally , more merry mirth , well joke , and bright repartee , you never hear over your mahogany , than you will hear over the half - inch white cedar of the whale - boat , when thus hang in hangman 's noose ; and , like the six burgher of calais before king edward , the six man compose the crew pull into the jaw of death , with a halter around every neck , as you may say .
perhaps a very little thought will now enable you to account for those repeat whaling disaster -- some few of which be casually chronicle -- of this man or that man be take out of the boat by the line , and lose . for , when the line be dart out , to be seat then in the boat , be like be seat in the midst of the manifold whizzing of a steam - engine in full play , when every fly beam , and shaft , and wheel , be graze you . it be bad ; for you can not sit motionless in the heart of these peril , because the boat be rock like a cradle , and you be pitch one way and the other , without the slight warning ; and only by a certain self - adjust buoyancy and simultaneousness of volition and action , can you escape be make a mazeppa of , and run away with where the all - see sun himself could never pierce you out .
again : as the profound calm which only apparently precede and prophesie of the storm , be perhaps more awful than the storm itself ; for , indeed , the calm be but the wrapper and envelope of the storm ; and contain it in itself , as the seemingly harmless rifle hold the fatal powder , and the ball , and the explosion ; so the graceful repose of the line , as it silently serpentine about the oarsman before be bring into actual play -- this be a thing which carry more of true terror than any other aspect of this dangerous affair . but why say more ? all man live envelop in whale - line . all be bear with halter round their neck ; but it be only when catch in the swift , sudden turn of death , that mortal realize the silent , subtle , ever - present peril of life . and if you be a philosopher , though seat in the whale - boat , you would not at heart feel one whit more of terror , than though seat before your evening fire with a poker , and not a harpoon , by your side .

accord to the invariable usage of the fishery , the whale - boat push off from the ship , with the headsman or whale - killer as temporary steersman , and the harpooneer or whale - fastener pull the foremost oar , the one know as the harpooneer - oar . now it need a strong , nervous arm to strike the first iron into the fish ; for often , in what be call a long dart , the heavy implement have to be fling to the distance of twenty or thirty foot . but however prolonged and exhaust the chase , the harpooneer be expect to pull his oar meanwhile to the uttermost ; indeed , he be expect to set an example of superhuman activity to the rest , not only by incredible rowing , but by repeat loud and intrepid exclamation ; and what it be to keep shout at the top of one 's compass , while all the other muscle be strained and half start -- what that be none know but those who have try it . for one , i can not bawl very heartily and work very recklessly at one and the same time . in this straining , bawl state , then , with his back to the fish , all at once the exhausted harpooneer hear the exciting cry--"stand up , and give it to he ! " he now have to drop and secure his oar , turn round on his centre half way , seize his harpoon from the crotch , and with what little strength may remain , he essay to pitch it somehow into the whale . no wonder , take the whole fleet of whaleman in a body , that out of fifty fair chance for a dart , not five be successful ; no wonder that so many hapless harpooneer be madly curse and disrate ; no wonder that some of they actually burst their blood - vessel in the boat ; no wonder that some sperm whaleman be absent four year with four barrel ; no wonder that to many ship owner , whale be but a lose concern ; for it be the harpooneer that make the voyage , and if you take the breath out of his body how can you expect to find it there when most want !
again , if the dart be successful , then at the second critical instant , that is , when the whale start to run , the boatheader and harpooneer likewise start to run fore and aft , to the imminent jeopardy of themselves and every one else . it be then they change place ; and the headsman , the chief officer of the little craft , take his proper station in the bow of the boat .
now , i care not who maintain the contrary , but all this be both foolish and unnecessary . the headsman should stay in the bow from first to last ; he should both dart the harpoon and the lance , and no rowing whatever should be expect of he , except under circumstance obvious to any fisherman . i know that this would sometimes involve a slight loss of speed in the chase ; but long experience in various whaleman of more than one nation have convince i that in the vast majority of failure in the fishery , it have not by any mean be so much the speed of the whale as the before describe exhaustion of the harpooneer that have cause they .
to insure the great efficiency in the dart , the harpooneer of this world must start to their foot from out of idleness , and not from out of toil .

the crotch allude to on a previous page deserve independent mention . it be a notched stick of a peculiar form , some two foot in length , which be perpendicularly insert into the starboard gunwale near the bow , for the purpose of furnish a rest for the wooden extremity of the harpoon , whose other naked , barbed end slopingly project from the prow . thereby the weapon be instantly at hand to its hurler , who snatch it up as readily from its rest as a backwoodsman swing his rifle from the wall . it be customary to have two harpoon repose in the crotch , respectively call the first and second iron .
but these two harpoon , each by its own cord , be both connect with the line ; the object be this : to dart they both , if possible , one instantly after the other into the same whale ; so that if , in the come drag , one should draw out , the other may still retain a hold . it be a doubling of the chance . but it very often happen that owe to the instantaneous , violent , convulsive run of the whale upon receive the first iron , it become impossible for the harpooneer , however lightning - like in his movement , to pitch the second iron into he . nevertheless , as the second iron be already connect with the line , and the line be run , hence that weapon must , at all event , be anticipatingly toss out of the boat , somehow and somewhere ; else the most terrible jeopardy would involve all hand . tumble into the water , it accordingly be in such case ; the spare coil of box line ( mention in a precede chapter ) make this feat , in most instance , prudently practicable . but this critical act be not always unattended with the sad and most fatal casualty .
furthermore : you must know that when the second iron be throw overboard , it thenceforth become a dangle , sharp - edge terror , skittishly curvet about both boat and whale , entangle the line , or cut they , and make a prodigious sensation in all direction . nor , in general , be it possible to secure it again until the whale be fairly capture and a corpse .
consider , now , how it must be in the case of four boat all engage one unusually strong , active , and know whale ; when owe to these quality in he , as well as to the thousand concur accident of such an audacious enterprise , eight or ten loose second iron may be simultaneously dangle about he . for , of course , each boat be supply with several harpoon to bend on to the line should the first one be ineffectually dart without recovery . all these particular be faithfully narrated here , as they will not fail to elucidate several most important , however intricate passage , in scene hereafter to be paint .

the whale as a dish .
that mortal man should feed upon the creature that feed his lamp , and , like stubb , eat he by his own light , as you may say ; this seem so outlandish a thing that one must need go a little into the history and philosophy of it .
it be upon record , that three century ago the tongue of the right whale be esteem a great delicacy in france , and command large price there . also , that in henry viiith 's time , a certain cook of the court obtain a handsome reward for invent an admirable sauce to be eat with barbacued porpoise , which , you remember , be a species of whale . porpoise , indeed , be to this day consider fine eating . the meat be make into ball about the size of billiard ball , and be well season and spice might be take for turtle - ball or veal ball . the old monk of dunfermline be very fond of they . they have a great porpoise grant from the crown .
the fact be , that among his hunter at least , the whale would by all hand be consider a noble dish , be there not so much of he ; but when you come to sit down before a meat - pie nearly one hundred foot long , it take away your appetite . only the most unprejudiced of man like stubb , nowadays partake of cooked whale ; but the esquimaux be not so fastidious . we all know how they live upon whale , and have rare old vintage of prime old train oil . zogranda , one of their most famous doctor , recommend strip of blubber for infant , as be exceedingly juicy and nourishing . and this remind i that certain englishmen , who long ago be accidentally leave in greenland by a whale vessel -- that these man actually live for several month on the mouldy scrap of whale which have be leave ashore after try out the blubber . among the dutch whaleman these scrap be call " fritter " ; which , indeed , they greatly resemble , be brown and crisp , and smell something like old amsterdam housewife ' dough - nuts or oly - cook , when fresh . they have such an eatable look that the most self - deny stranger can hardly keep his hand off .
but what far depreciate the whale as a civilized dish , be his exceed richness . he be the great prize ox of the sea , too fat to be delicately good . look at his hump , which would be as fine eating as the buffalo 's ( which be esteem a rare dish ) , be it not such a solid pyramid of fat . but the spermaceti itself , how bland and creamy that be ; like the transparent , half - jelly , white meat of a cocoanut in the third month of its growth , yet far too rich to supply a substitute for butter . nevertheless , many whaleman have a method of absorb it into some other substance , and then partake of it . in the long try watch of the night it be a common thing for the seaman to dip their ship - biscuit into the huge oil - pot and let they fry there awhile . many a good supper have i thus make .
in the case of a small sperm whale the brain be account a fine dish . the casket of the skull be break into with an axe , and the two plump , whitish lob be withdraw ( precisely resemble two large pudding ) , they be then mix with flour , and cook into a most delectable mess , in flavor somewhat resemble calf ' head , which be quite a dish among some epicure ; and every one know that some young buck among the epicure , by continually din upon calf ' brain , by and by get to have a little brain of their own , so as to be able to tell a calf 's head from their own head ; which , indeed , require uncommon discrimination . and that be the reason why a young buck with an intelligent look calf 's head before he , be somehow one of the sad sight you can see . the head look a sort of reproachfully at he , with an " et tu brute ! " expression .
it be not , perhaps , entirely because the whale be so excessively unctuous that landsman seem to regard the eating of he with abhorrence ; that appear to result , in some way , from the consideration before mention : i.e. that a man should eat a newly murder thing of the sea , and eat it too by its own light . but no doubt the first man that ever murder an ox be regard as a murderer ; perhaps he be hung ; and if he have be put on his trial by oxen , he certainly would have be ; and he certainly deserve it if any murderer do . go to the meat - market of a saturday night and see the crowd of live biped star up at the long row of dead quadruped . do not that sight take a tooth out of the cannibal 's jaw ? cannibal ? who be not a cannibal ? i tell you it will be more tolerable for the fejee that salt down a lean missionary in his cellar against a come famine ; it will be more tolerable for that provident fejee , i say , in the day of judgment , than for thee , civilized and enlightened gourmand , who nailest goose to the ground and feastest on their bloated liver in thy pate - de - foie - gra .
but stubb , he eat the whale by its own light , do he ? and that be add insult to injury , be it ? look at your knife - handle , there , my civilized and enlightened gourmand dining off that roast beef , what be that handle make of?--what but the bone of the brother of the very ox you be eat ? and what do you pick your tooth with , after devour that fat goose ? with a feather of the same fowl . and with what quill do the secretary of the society for the suppression of cruelty to gander formally indite his circular ? it be only within the last month or two that that society pass a resolution to patronise nothing but steel pen .

when in the southern fishery , a capture sperm whale , after long and weary toil , be bring alongside late at night , it be not , as a general thing at least , customary to proceed at once to the business of cut he in . for that business be an exceedingly laborious one ; be not very soon complete ; and require all hand to set about it . therefore , the common usage be to take in all sail ; lash the helm a'lee ; and then send every one below to his hammock till daylight , with the reservation that , until that time , anchor - watch shall be keep ; that is , two and two for an hour , each couple , the crew in rotation shall mount the deck to see that all go well .
but sometimes , especially upon the line in the pacific , this plan will not answer at all ; because such incalculable host of shark gather round the moor carcase , that be he leave so for six hour , say , on a stretch , little more than the skeleton would be visible by morning . in most other part of the ocean , however , where these fish do not so largely abound , their wondrous voracity can be at time considerably diminish , by vigorously stir they up with sharp whaling - spade , a procedure notwithstanding , which , in some instance , only seem to tickle they into still great activity . but it be not thus in the present case with the pequod 's shark ; though , to be sure , any man unaccustomed to such sight , to have look over her side that night , would have almost think the whole round sea be one huge cheese , and those shark the maggot in it .

the blanket .
i have give no small attention to that not unvexed subject , the skin of the whale . i have have controversy about it with experienced whaleman afloat , and learn naturalist ashore . my original opinion remain unchanged ; but it be only an opinion .
the question be , what and where be the skin of the whale ? already you know what his blubber be . that blubber be something of the consistence of firm , close - grain beef , but tough , more elastic and compact , and range from eight or ten to twelve and fifteen inch in thickness .
now , however preposterous it may at first seem to talk of any creature 's skin as be of that sort of consistence and thickness , yet in point of fact these be no argument against such a presumption ; because you can not raise any other dense enveloping layer from the whale 's body but that same blubber ; and the outermost envelop layer of any animal , if reasonably dense , what can that be but the skin ? true , from the unmarred dead body of the whale , you may scrape off with your hand an infinitely thin , transparent substance , somewhat resemble the thin shred of isinglass , only it be almost as flexible and soft as satin ; that be , previous to be dry , when it not only contract and thicken , but become rather hard and brittle . i have several such dried bit , which i use for mark in my whale - book . it be transparent , as i say before ; and be lay upon the print page , i have sometimes please myself with fancy it exert a magnifying influence . at any rate , it be pleasant to read about whale through their own spectacle , as you may say . but what i be drive at here be this . that same infinitely thin , isinglass substance , which , i admit , invest the entire body of the whale , be not so much to be regard as the skin of the creature , as the skin of the skin , so to speak ; for it be simply ridiculous to say , that the proper skin of the tremendous whale be thin and more tender than the skin of a new - bear child . but no more of this .
assume the blubber to be the skin of the whale ; then , when this skin , as in the case of a very large sperm whale , will yield the bulk of one hundred barrel of oil ; and , when it be consider that , in quantity , or rather weight , that oil , in its express state , be only three fourth , and not the entire substance of the coat ; some idea may hence be have of the enormousness of that animate mass , a mere part of whose mere integument yield such a lake of liquid as that . reckon ten barrel to the ton , you have ten ton for the net weight of only three quarter of the stuff of the whale 's skin .
in life , the visible surface of the sperm whale be not the least among the many marvel he present . almost invariably it be all over obliquely cross and re - crossed with numberless straight mark in thick array , something like those in the fine italian line engraving . but these mark do not seem to be impress upon the isinglass substance above mention , but seem to be see through it , as if they be engrave upon the body itself . nor be this all . in some instance , to the quick , observant eye , those linear mark , as in a veritable engraving , but afford the ground for far other delineation . these be hieroglyphical ; that be , if you call those mysterious cypher on the wall of pyramid hieroglyphic , then that be the proper word to use in the present connexion . by my retentive memory of the hieroglyphic upon one sperm whale in particular , i be much strike with a plate represent the old indian character chisel on the famous hieroglyphic palisade on the bank of the upper mississippi . like those mystic rock , too , the mystic - mark whale remain undecipherable . this allusion to the indian rock remind i of another thing . besides all the other phenomenon which the exterior of the sperm whale present , he not seldom display the back , and more especially his flank , efface in great part of the regular linear appearance , by reason of numerous rude scratch , altogether of an irregular , random aspect . i should say that those new england rock on the sea - coast , which agassiz imagine to bear the mark of violent scrap contact with vast float iceberg -- i should say , that those rock must not a little resemble the sperm whale in this particular . it also seem to i that such scratch in the whale be probably make by hostile contact with other whale ; for i have most remark they in the large , full - grow bull of the specie .
a word or two more concern this matter of the skin or blubber of the whale . it have already be say , that it be stript from he in long piece , call blanket - piece . like most sea - term , this one be very happy and significant . for the whale be indeed wrapt up in his blubber as in a real blanket or counterpane ; or , still well , an indian poncho slipt over his head , and skirt his extremity . it be by reason of this cosy blanketing of his body , that the whale be enable to keep himself comfortable in all weather , in all sea , time , and tide . what would become of a greenland whale , say , in those shudder , icy sea of the north , if unsupplie with his cosy surtout ? true , other fish be find exceedingly brisk in those hyperborean water ; but these , be it observe , be your cold - blooded , lungless fish , whose very belly be refrigerator ; creature , that warm themselves under the lee of an iceberg , as a traveller in winter would bask before an inn fire ; whereas , like man , the whale have lung and warm blood . freeze his blood , and he die . how wonderful be it then -- except after explanation -- that this great monster , to whom corporeal warmth be as indispensable as it be to man ; how wonderful that he should be find at home , immerse to his lip for life in those arctic water ! where , when seaman fall overboard , they be sometimes find , month afterwards , perpendicularly freeze into the heart of field of ice , as a fly be find glue in amber . but more surprising be it to know , as have be prove by experiment , that the blood of a polar whale be warm than that of a borneo negro in summer .
it do seem to i , that herein we see the rare virtue of a strong individual vitality , and the rare virtue of thick wall , and the rare virtue of interior spaciousness . oh , man ! admire and model thyself after the whale ! do thou , too , remain warm among ice . do thou , too , live in this world without be of it . be cool at the equator ; keep thy blood fluid at the pole . like the great dome of st. peter 's , and like the great whale , retain , o man ! in all season a temperature of thine own .
but how easy and how hopeless to teach these fine thing ! of erection , how few be dome like st. peter 's ! of creature , how few vast as the whale !

the sperm whale 's head -- contrast view .
here , now , be two great whale , lay their head together ; let we join they , and lie together our own .
of the grand order of folio leviathan , the sperm whale and the right whale be by far the most noteworthy . they be the only whale regularly hunt by man . to the nantucketer , they present the two extreme of all the known variety of the whale . as the external difference between they be mainly observable in their head ; and as a head of each be this moment hang from the pequod 's side ; and as we may freely go from one to the other , by merely step across the deck:--where , i should like to know , will you obtain a well chance to study practical cetology than here ?
in the first place , you be strike by the general contrast between these head . both be massive enough in all conscience ; but there be a certain mathematical symmetry in the sperm whale 's which the right whale 's sadly lack . there be more character in the sperm whale 's head . as you behold it , you involuntarily yield the immense superiority to he , in point of pervade dignity . in the present instance , too , this dignity be heighten by the pepper and salt colour of his head at the summit , give token of advanced age and large experience . in short , he be what the fisherman technically call a " grey - head whale . "
let we now note what be least dissimilar in these head -- namely , the two most important organ , the eye and the ear . far back on the side of the head , and low down , near the angle of either whale 's jaw , if you narrowly search , you will at last see a lashless eye , which you would fancy to be a young colt 's eye ; so out of all proportion be it to the magnitude of the head .
now , from this peculiar sideway position of the whale 's eye , it be plain that he can never see an object which be exactly ahead , no more than he can one exactly astern . in a word , the position of the whale 's eye correspond to that of a man 's ear ; and you may fancy , for yourself , how it would fare with you , do you sideways survey object through your ear . you would find that you could only command some thirty degree of vision in advance of the straight side - line of sight ; and about thirty more behind it . if your bitter foe be walk straight towards you , with dagger uplifted in broad day , you would not be able to see he , any more than if he be steal upon you from behind . in a word , you would have two back , so to speak ; but , at the same time , also , two front ( side front ): for what be it that make the front of a man -- what , indeed , but his eye ?
moreover , while in most other animal that i can now think of , the eye be so plant as imperceptibly to blend their visual power , so as to produce one picture and not two to the brain ; the peculiar position of the whale 's eye , effectually divide as they be by many cubic foot of solid head , which tower between they like a great mountain separate two lake in valley ; this , of course , must wholly separate the impression which each independent organ impart . the whale , therefore , must see one distinct picture on this side , and another distinct picture on that side ; while all between must be profound darkness and nothingness to he . man may , in effect , be say to look out on the world from a sentry - box with two joined sash for his window . but with the whale , these two sash be separately insert , make two distinct window , but sadly impair the view . this peculiarity of the whale 's eye be a thing always to be bear in mind in the fishery ; and to be remember by the reader in some subsequent scene .
a curious and most puzzling question might be start concern this visual matter as touch the leviathan . but i must be content with a hint . so long as a man 's eye be open in the light , the act of seeing be involuntary ; that is , he can not then help mechanically see whatever object be before he . nevertheless , any one 's experience will teach he , that though he can take in an undiscriminating sweep of thing at one glance , it be quite impossible for he , attentively , and completely , to examine any two thing -- however large or however small -- at one and the same instant of time ; never mind if they lie side by side and touch each other . but if you now come to separate these two object , and surround each by a circle of profound darkness ; then , in order to see one of they , in such a manner as to bring your mind to bear on it , the other will be utterly exclude from your contemporary consciousness . how be it , then , with the whale ? true , both his eye , in themselves , must simultaneously act ; but be his brain so much more comprehensive , combine , and subtle than man 's , that he can at the same moment of time attentively examine two distinct prospect , one on one side of he , and the other in an exactly opposite direction ? if he can , then be it as marvellous a thing in he , as if a man be able simultaneously to go through the demonstration of two distinct problem in euclid . nor , strictly investigate , be there any incongruity in this comparison .

let we , then , look at this matter , along with some interesting item contingent . every one know that by the peculiar cunning of their gill , the finny tribe in general breathe the air which at all time be combine with the element in which they swim ; hence , a herring or a cod might live a century , and never once raise its head above the surface . but owe to his marked internal structure which give he regular lung , like a human being 's , the whale can only live by inhale the disengage air in the open atmosphere . wherefore the necessity for his periodical visit to the upper world . but he can not in any degree breathe through his mouth , for , in his ordinary attitude , the sperm whale 's mouth be bury at least eight foot beneath the surface ; and what be still more , his windpipe have no connexion with his mouth . no , he breathe through his spiracle alone ; and this be on the top of his head .
if i say , that in any creature breathing be only a function indispensable to vitality , inasmuch as it withdraw from the air a certain element , which be subsequently bring into contact with the blood impart to the blood its vivifying principle , i do not think i shall err ; though i may possibly use some superfluous scientific word . assume it , and it follow that if all the blood in a man could be aerate with one breath , he might then seal up his nostril and not fetch another for a considerable time . that be to say , he would then live without breathe . anomalous as it may seem , this be precisely the case with the whale , who systematically live , by interval , his full hour and more ( when at the bottom ) without draw a single breath , or so much as in any way inhale a particle of air ; for , remember , he have no gill . how be this ? in man , breathing be incessantly go on -- one breath only serve for two or three pulsation ; so that whatever other business he have to attend to , wake or sleep , breathe he must , or die he will . but the sperm whale only breathe about one seventh or sunday of his time .

the tail .
other poet have warble the praise of the soft eye of the antelope , and the lovely plumage of the bird that never alight ; less celestial , i celebrate a tail .
reckon the large sized sperm whale 's tail to begin at that point of the trunk where it taper to about the girth of a man , it comprise upon its upper surface alone , an area of at least fifty square foot . the compact round body of its root expand into two broad , firm , flat palm or fluke , gradually shoal away to less than an inch in thickness . at the crotch or junction , these fluke slightly overlap , then sideways recede from each other like wing , leave a wide vacancy between . in no living thing be the line of beauty more exquisitely define than in the crescentic border of these fluke . at its utmost expansion in the full grown whale , the tail will considerably exceed twenty foot across .
the entire member seem a dense web bed of weld sinew ; but cut into it , and you find that three distinct strata compose it:--upper , middle , and low . the fibre in the upper and low layer , be long and horizontal ; those of the middle one , very short , and run crosswise between the outside layer . this triune structure , as much as anything else , impart power to the tail . to the student of old roman wall , the middle layer will furnish a curious parallel to the thin course of tile always alternate with the stone in those wonderful relic of the antique , and which undoubtedly contribute so much to the great strength of the masonry .
but as if this vast local power in the tendinous tail be not enough , the whole bulk of the leviathan be knit over with a warp and woof of muscular fibre and filament , which pass on either side the loin and run down into the fluke , insensibly blend with they , and largely contribute to their might ; so that in the tail the confluent measureless force of the whole whale seem concentrate to a point . could annihilation occur to matter , this be the thing to do it .
nor do this -- its amazing strength , at all tend to cripple the graceful flexion of its motion ; where infantileness of ease undulate through a titanism of power . on the contrary , those motion derive their most appalling beauty from it . real strength never impairs beauty or harmony , but it often bestow it ; and in everything imposingly beautiful , strength have much to do with the magic . take away the tie tendon that all over seem burst from the marble in the carve hercules , and its charm would be go . as devout eckerman lift the linen sheet from the naked corpse of goethe , he be overwhelm with the massive chest of the man , that seem as a roman triumphal arch . when angelo paint even god the father in human form , mark what robustness be there . and whatever they may reveal of the divine love in the son , the soft , curled , hermaphroditical italian picture , in which his idea have be most successfully embody ; these picture , so destitute as they be of all brawniness , hint nothing of any power , but the mere negative , feminine one of submission and endurance , which on all hand it be concede , form the peculiar practical virtue of his teaching .
such be the subtle elasticity of the organ i treat of , that whether wield in sport , or in earnest , or in anger , whatever be the mood it be in , its flexion be invariably mark by exceed grace . therein no fairy 's arm can transcend it .
five great motion be peculiar to it . first , when use as a fin for progression ; second , when use as a mace in battle ; third , in sweep ; fourth , in lobtailing ; fifth , in peak fluke .
first : be horizontal in its position , the leviathan 's tail act in a different manner from the tail of all other sea creature . it never wriggle . in man or fish , wriggling be a sign of inferiority . to the whale , his tail be the sole mean of propulsion . scroll - wise coil forwards beneath the body , and then rapidly spring backwards , it be this which give that singular darting , leap motion to the monster when furiously swim . his side - fin only serve to steer by .
second : it be a little significant , that while one sperm whale only fight another sperm whale with his head and jaw , nevertheless , in his conflict with man , he chiefly and contemptuously use his tail . in strike at a boat , he swiftly curve away his fluke from it , and the blow be only inflict by the recoil . if it be make in the unobstructed air , especially if it descend to its mark , the stroke be then simply irresistible . no rib of man or boat can withstand it . your only salvation lie in elude it ; but if it come sideways through the oppose water , then partly owe to the light buoyancy of the whale boat , and the elasticity of its material , a crack rib or a dash plank or two , a sort of stitch in the side , be generally the most serious result . these submerge side blow be so often receive in the fishery , that they be account mere child 's play . some one strip off a frock , and the hole be stop .
third : i can not demonstrate it , but it seem to i , that in the whale the sense of touch be concentrate in the tail ; for in this respect there be a delicacy in it only equal by the daintiness of the elephant 's trunk . this delicacy be chiefly evince in the action of sweep , when in maidenly gentleness the whale with a certain soft slowness move his immense fluke from side to side upon the surface of the sea ; and if he feel but a sailor 's whisker , woe to that sailor , whisker and all . what tenderness there be in that preliminary touch ! have this tail any prehensile power , i should straightway bethink i of darmonodes ' elephant that so frequent the flower - market , and with low salutation present nosegay to damsel , and then caress their zone . on more account than one , a pity it be that the whale do not possess this prehensile virtue in his tail ; for i have hear of yet another elephant , that when wound in the fight , curve round his trunk and extract the dart .

another point of difference between the male and female school be still more characteristic of the sex . say you strike a forty - barrel - bull -- poor devil ! all his comrade quit he . but strike a member of the harem school , and her companion swim around she with every token of concern , sometimes linger so near she and so long , as themselves to fall a prey .
