fast - fish and loose - fish .
the allusion to the waif and waif - pole in the last chapter but one , necessitate some account of the law and regulation of the whale fishery , of which the waif may be deem the grand symbol and badge .
it frequently happen that when several ship be cruise in company , a whale may be strike by one vessel , then escape , and be finally kill and capture by another vessel ; and herein be indirectly comprise many minor contingency , all partake of this one grand feature . for example,--after a weary and perilous chase and capture of a whale , the body may get loose from the ship by reason of a violent storm ; and drift far away to leeward , be retake by a second whaler , who , in a calm , snugly tow it alongside , without risk of life or line . thus the most vexatious and violent dispute would often arise between the fisherman , be there not some write or unwritten , universal , undisputed law applicable to all case .
perhaps the only formal whaling code authorize by legislative enactment , be that of holland . it be decree by the states - general in a.d. 1695 . but though no other nation have ever have any write whaling law , yet the american fisherman have be their own legislator and lawyer in this matter . they have provide a system which for terse comprehensiveness surpass justinian 's pandects and the by - law of the chinese society for the suppression of meddling with other people 's business . yes ; these law might be engraven on a queen anne 's forthing , or the barb of a harpoon , and wear round the neck , so small be they .
i. a fast - fish belong to the party fast to it .
ii . a loose - fish be fair game for anybody who can soon catch it .
but what play the mischief with this masterly code be the admirable brevity of it , which necessitate a vast volume of commentary to expound it .
first : what be a fast - fish ? alive or dead a fish be technically fast , when it be connect with an occupy ship or boat , by any medium at all controllable by the occupant or occupants,--a mast , an oar , a nine - inch cable , a telegraph wire , or a strand of cobweb , it be all the same . likewise a fish be technically fast when it bear a waif , or any other recognise symbol of possession ; so long as the party waife it plainly evince their ability at any time to take it alongside , as well as their intention so to do .
these be scientific commentary ; but the commentary of the whaleman themselves sometimes consist in hard word and hard knock -- the coke - upon - littleton of the fist . true , among the more upright and honourable whaleman allowance be always make for peculiar case , where it would be an outrageous moral injustice for one party to claim possession of a whale previously chase or kill by another party . but other be by no mean so scrupulous .
some fifty year ago there be a curious case of whale - trover litigate in england , wherein the plaintiff set forth that after a hard chase of a whale in the northern sea ; and when indeed they ( the plaintiff ) have succeed in harpoon the fish ; they be at last , through peril of their life , oblige to forsake not only their line , but their boat itself . ultimately the defendant ( the crew of another ship ) come up with the whale , strike , kill , seize , and finally appropriate it before the very eye of the plaintiff . and when those defendant be remonstrate with , their captain snap his finger in the plaintiff ' tooth , and assure they that by way of doxology to the deed he have do , he would now retain their line , harpoon , and boat , which have remain attach to the whale at the time of the seizure . wherefore the plaintiff now sue for the recovery of the value of their whale , line , harpoon , and boat .
mr. erskine be counsel for the defendant ; lord ellenborough be the judge . in the course of the defence , the witty erskine go on to illustrate his position , by allude to a recent crim . con . case , wherein a gentleman , after in vain try to bridle his wife 's viciousness , have at last abandon she upon the sea of life ; but in the course of year , repent of that step , he institute an action to recover possession of she . erskine be on the other side ; and he then support it by say , that though the gentleman have originally harpoon the lady , and have once have she fast , and only by reason of the great stress of she plunge viciousness , have at last abandon she ; yet abandon she he do , so that she become a loose - fish ; and therefore when a subsequent gentleman re - harpoon she , the lady then become that subsequent gentleman 's property , along with whatever harpoon might have be find stick in she .
now in the present case erskine contend that the example of the whale and the lady be reciprocally illustrative of each other .
these pleading , and the counter pleading , be duly hear , the very learn judge in set term decide , to wit,--that as for the boat , he award it to the plaintiff , because they have merely abandon it to save their life ; but that with regard to the controvert whale , harpoon , and line , they belong to the defendant ; the whale , because it be a loose - fish at the time of the final capture ; and the harpoon and line because when the fish make off with they , it ( the fish ) acquire a property in those article ; and hence anybody who afterwards take the fish have a right to they . now the defendant afterwards take the fish ; ergo , the aforesaid article be theirs .
a common man look at this decision of the very learn judge , might possibly object to it . but plough up to the primary rock of the matter , the two great principle lay down in the twin whale law previously quote , and apply and elucidate by lord ellenborough in the above cite case ; these two law touch fast - fish and loose - fish , i say , will , on reflection , be find the fundamental of all human jurisprudence ; for notwithstanding its complicated tracery of sculpture , the temple of the law , like the temple of the philistines , have but two prop to stand on .
be it not a saying in every one 's mouth , possession be half of the law : that be , regardless of how the thing come into possession ? but often possession be the whole of the law . what be the sinew and soul of russian serf and republican slave but fast - fish , whereof possession be the whole of the law ? what to the rapacious landlord be the widow 's last mite but a fast - fish ? what be yonder undetected villain 's marble mansion with a door - plate for a waif ; what be that but a fast - fish ? what be the ruinous discount which mordecai , the broker , get from poor woebegone , the bankrupt , on a loan to keep woebegone 's family from starvation ; what be that ruinous discount but a fast - fish ? what be the archbishop of savesoul 's income of l100,000 seize from the scant bread and cheese of hundred of thousand of break - back laborer ( all sure of heaven without any of savesoul 's help ) what be that globular l100,000 but a fast - fish ? what be the duke of dunder 's hereditary town and hamlet but fast - fish ? what to that redoubte harpooneer , john bull , be poor ireland , but a fast - fish ? what to that apostolic lancer , brother jonathan , be texas but a fast - fish ? and concern all these , be not possession the whole of the law ?
but if the doctrine of fast - fish be pretty generally applicable , the kindre doctrine of loose - fish be still more widely so . that be internationally and universally applicable .
what be america in 1492 but a loose - fish , in which columbus strike the spanish standard by way of waife it for his royal master and mistress ? what be poland to the czar ? what greece to the turk ? what india to england ? what at last will mexico be to the united states ? all loose - fish .
what be the rights of man and the liberties of the world but loose - fish ? what all man 's mind and opinion but loose - fish ? what be the principle of religious belief in they but a loose - fish ? what to the ostentatious smuggling verbalist be the thought of thinker but loose - fish ? what be the great globe itself but a loose - fish ? and what be you , reader , but a loose - fish and a fast - fish , too ?

look not too long in the face of the fire , o man ! never dream with thy hand on the helm ! turn not thy back to the compass ; accept the first hint of the hitching tiller ; believe not the artificial fire , when its redness make all thing look ghastly . to - morrow , in the natural sun , the sky will be bright ; those who glare like devil in the forking flame , the morn will show in far other , at least gentle , relief ; the glorious , golden , glad sun , the only true lamp -- all other but liar !
nevertheless the sun hide not virginia 's dismal swamp , nor rome 's accurse campagna , nor wide sahara , nor all the million of mile of desert and of grief beneath the moon . the sun hide not the ocean , which be the dark side of this earth , and which be two third of this earth . so , therefore , that mortal man who hath more of joy than sorrow in he , that mortal man can not be true -- not true , or undeveloped . with book the same . the truest of all man be the man of sorrows , and the truest of all book be solomon 's , and ecclesiastes be the fine hammer steel of woe . " all be vanity . " all . this wilful world hath not get hold of unchristian solomon 's wisdom yet . but he who dodge hospital and jail , and walk fast crossing graveyard , and would rather talk of opera than hell ; call cowper , young , pascal , rousseau , poor devil all of sick man ; and throughout a care - free lifetime swear by rabelais as pass wise , and therefore jolly;--not that man be fit to sit down on tomb - stone , and break the green damp mould with unfathomably wondrous solomon .
but even solomon , he say , " the man that wandereth out of the way of understanding shall remain " ( i.e. , even while live ) " in the congregation of the dead . " give not thyself up , then , to fire , lest it invert thee , deaden thee ; as for the time it do i . there be a wisdom that be woe ; but there be a woe that be madness . and there be a catskill eagle in some soul that can alike dive down into the black gorge , and soar out of they again and become invisible in the sunny space . and even if he for ever fly within the gorge , that gorge be in the mountain ; so that even in his low swoop the mountain eagle be still high than other bird upon the plain , even though they soar .
